existingRoleRecommendations.name: Onboarding Agent
existingRoleRecommendations.currentResponsibility: Coordinate accepted-offer onboarding and readiness handoffs.
existingRoleRecommendations.change: Retain accepted-offer readiness; explicitly hand worker-master setup to Employee Changes and application/learning/asset outcomes to their coordinators.
existingRoleRecommendations.rationale: Composite membership currently spills into shared services; it must not imply sole ownership.

existingRoleRecommendations.name: Offboarding Agent
existingRoleRecommendations.currentResponsibility: Coordinate separation preparation and exit-control handoffs; final closure is unavailable.
existingRoleRecommendations.change: Add restructure coordination, with Compliance/ER consultation and human decisions; preserve unavailable final closure.
existingRoleRecommendations.rationale: Restructure preparation is not termination authority; existing exit control mappings are broader than executable support.

existingRoleRecommendations.name: Employee Changes Agent
existingRoleRecommendations.currentResponsibility: Coordinate employment, organization, position and employee record changes.
existingRoleRecommendations.change: Add explicit worker-master setup, data-quality/reporting and governed workforce-change coordination.
existingRoleRecommendations.rationale: Extends existing worker/org stewardship instead of proliferating data/report/planning roles.

existingRoleRecommendations.name: Payroll Agent
existingRoleRecommendations.currentResponsibility: Coordinate pay inputs, corrections and statutory-pay requests; no payroll calculation executor.
existingRoleRecommendations.change: Retain pay coordination; distinguish reward decisions, time approval, calculation, release and filing/remittance receipts.
existingRoleRecommendations.rationale: Association is not a payroll calculation or payment adapter.

existingRoleRecommendations.name: Benefits Agent
existingRoleRecommendations.currentResponsibility: Coordinate benefit eligibility, elections, claims and evidence handoffs.
existingRoleRecommendations.change: Add nonclinical wellbeing navigation; keep carrier decisions, pension advice and clinical/crisis judgments human/provider-owned.
existingRoleRecommendations.rationale: Existing pension-wellbeing association does not cover the separate wellbeing service.

existingRoleRecommendations.name: Leave Agent
existingRoleRecommendations.currentResponsibility: Coordinate absence, protected leave and return-to-work requests.
existingRoleRecommendations.change: Retain absence entitlement; explicitly collaborate with Time & Attendance and Payroll for payable-time handoffs.
existingRoleRecommendations.rationale: Leave approval and payroll receipt are separate outcomes.

existingRoleRecommendations.name: Compliance Agent
existingRoleRecommendations.currentResponsibility: Coordinate work eligibility, screening, safety and compliance review; never make professional determinations.
existingRoleRecommendations.change: Retain coordination but replace implied general professional ownership with named screening/safety/legal/occupational-health handoffs; collaborate on ER and restructuring.
existingRoleRecommendations.rationale: Its broad safety/accommodation/labor mappings require qualified human boundaries, not an autonomous compliance decision maker.

existingRoleRecommendations.name: IT Access Agent
existingRoleRecommendations.currentResponsibility: Coordinate identity and access requests with independent application-owner decisions.
existingRoleRecommendations.change: Retain reusable access coordinator; add explicit cancellation revocation collaboration and separate request communication from IAM completion.
existingRoleRecommendations.rationale: Standalone access is context reuse; admin communication exceptions are not provisioning authority.

existingRoleRecommendations.name: Learning Agent
existingRoleRecommendations.currentResponsibility: Coordinate learning, skills, credentials and career-development requests.
existingRoleRecommendations.change: Retain learning/credential/career coordination; distinguish policy acknowledgment from learning and succession/ratings from development.
existingRoleRecommendations.rationale: Canonical shared learning assignment does not imply enrollment or certification.

existingRoleRecommendations.name: Mobility Agent
existingRoleRecommendations.currentResponsibility: Coordinate internal moves, immigration, relocation and remote-work handoffs.
existingRoleRecommendations.change: Retain transfers/immigration/remote-work coordination with explicit country approval and source cutover dependencies.
existingRoleRecommendations.rationale: Existing controlled transfer code is not general registered-agent transfer execution.

existingRoleRecommendations.name: Documents & Records Agent
existingRoleRecommendations.currentResponsibility: Coordinate governed documents, retention and privacy-rights requests.
existingRoleRecommendations.change: Retain document/record coordination; collaborate on policy acknowledgments and governed report disclosures without activating deferred privacy workflows.
existingRoleRecommendations.rationale: Record custody, authenticity and legal disclosure are separate responsibilities.

existingRoleRecommendations.name: HR Helpdesk Agent
existingRoleRecommendations.currentResponsibility: Coordinate HR enquiries, knowledge and case-management requests.
existingRoleRecommendations.change: Keep front-door triage and knowledge; hand recruiting outcomes to Recruiting while retaining published FAQs as collaborator.
existingRoleRecommendations.rationale: Its recruiting self-service mapping alone must not imply ATS selection capability.

existingRoleRecommendations.name: Assets & Workplace Agent
existingRoleRecommendations.currentResponsibility: Support equipment custody, facilities and workplace handoffs.
existingRoleRecommendations.change: Keep support role; explicitly collaborate on cancellation recovery and exit controls, distinguishing shipment, custody and facilities access.
existingRoleRecommendations.rationale: Supporting overlap is appropriate; it does not own final onboarding or exit closure.

existingRoleRecommendations.name: Document Verification Agent
existingRoleRecommendations.currentResponsibility: Support document evidence review; local checks are not source authentication.
existingRoleRecommendations.change: Keep evidence support without accountable domain ownership; distinguish malware/local checks, source authentication and professional adjudication.
existingRoleRecommendations.rationale: Existing local checks cannot verify issuer authenticity or release quarantined findings.

existingRoleRecommendations.name: Systems Watcher Agent
existingRoleRecommendations.currentResponsibility: Support system health observation and escalation. Existing connector watchers are not this registered principal.
existingRoleRecommendations.change: Retain health observation support; do not add atomic domain ownership or treat connector watchers as this registered principal.
existingRoleRecommendations.rationale: Deterministic connector monitors already exist; a new monitoring role is not justified.

proposedRoleRecommendations.name: Recruiting Coordination Agent
proposedRoleRecommendations.boundary: Candidate/requisition/offer coordination before accepted-offer handoff; no selection or eligibility decision.
proposedRoleRecommendations.extendExisting: Extending Onboarding conflates pre-offer selection with post-acceptance readiness; Helpdesk remains suitable for public process FAQs but not ATS progression.
proposedRoleRecommendations.deterministicAlternative: Use deterministic ATS transitions/templates for simple approved moves; a coordinator is justified only for multi-party exceptions and handoffs.
proposedRoleRecommendations.justification: Distinct candidate lifecycle, ATS evidence and recruiter accountability; approve only if recruiting is in the product delivery scope.
humanDecisionBoundaries: Recruiter/hiring manager approves requisitions, selection, eligibility, offer terms and referral awards; grounded published information alone needs no selection decision.
requiredFutureSystems: approved job and recruiting knowledge base
proposedRoleRecommendations.requiredInputs: Current scoped subject/request, approved source object and policy versions, named human sponsor/decision, applicable evidence; outcome-specific schemas still need approval.
proposedCompletionEvidence: ATS object/stage version or cited information response and delivery record; approved offer is not accepted offer.
proposedRoleRecommendations.currentCapability: not registered or implemented; proposal only

proposedRoleRecommendations.name: Compensation & Rewards Coordination Agent
proposedRoleRecommendations.boundary: Reward-plan and award coordination, excluding payroll calculation, pay decisions and investment/tax advice.
proposedRoleRecommendations.extendExisting: Payroll receives approved pay inputs; letting it own discretionary reward proposals and approval weakens segregation of duties.
proposedRoleRecommendations.deterministicAlternative: Plan formulas, eligibility/budget checks and postings belong in deterministic tools; use a coordinator for approvals/exceptions, not calculations.
proposedRoleRecommendations.justification: Distinct plan versions, discretionary decisions and reward/equity ledgers; no separate equity or recognition agent needed.
humanDecisionBoundaries: Compensation committee/authorized manager decides eligibility, pay changes, equity and awards; AI never sets pay or determines fair compensation.
proposedRoleRecommendations.requiredInputs: Current scoped subject/request, approved source object and policy versions, named human sponsor/decision, applicable evidence; outcome-specific schemas still need approval.
proposedCompletionEvidence: Approved plan/decision version and applied compensation or award ledger receipt; payroll posting alone cannot approve reward.
proposedRoleRecommendations.currentCapability: not registered or implemented; proposal only

proposedRoleRecommendations.name: Time & Attendance Coordination Agent
proposedRoleRecommendations.boundary: Worked time, schedules, overtime and payroll cutoff handoffs; Leave retains entitlement decisions.
proposedRoleRecommendations.extendExisting: Leave could absorb low-volume time requests, but worked-time locking, scheduling and overtime have distinct evidence and operational cadence.
proposedRoleRecommendations.deterministicAlternative: Clock validation and payable-time conversion stay deterministic; reassess need if the existing time platform handles all exception routing.
proposedRoleRecommendations.justification: Five explicitly unmapped service groups share one coherent time-to-pay boundary, rather than five agents.
humanDecisionBoundaries: Manager/time administrator approves payable time, schedules, overtime and disputes; hours-to-pay rules require approved jurisdiction/collective policy.
proposedRoleRecommendations.requiredInputs: Current scoped subject/request, approved source object and policy versions, named human sponsor/decision, applicable evidence; outcome-specific schemas still need approval.
proposedCompletionEvidence: Dated punch/time/schedule version and relevant manager decision or payroll interface receipt.
proposedRoleRecommendations.currentCapability: not registered or implemented; proposal only

proposedRoleRecommendations.name: Performance & Talent Coordination Agent
proposedRoleRecommendations.boundary: Review/talent/succession/retention coordination; no ratings, selection, attrition conclusions or resume-integrity determinations.
proposedRoleRecommendations.extendExisting: Learning supports development but cannot own manager ratings or talent-panel choices; Employee Changes owns records, not evaluation.
proposedRoleRecommendations.deterministicAlternative: Calendars and plan validation use deterministic tools; qualitative evidence handoff may justify coordination after criteria and human review are approved.
proposedRoleRecommendations.justification: Shared review evidence and human-panel boundary across seven services. Talent at Risk model implementation remains a separate workstream.
humanDecisionBoundaries: Managers/talent panels approve goals, ratings, improvement plans, succession and retention actions; predictions are review signals, never employment decisions.
proposedRoleRecommendations.requiredInputs: Current scoped subject/request, approved source object and policy versions, named human sponsor/decision, applicable evidence; outcome-specific schemas still need approval.
proposedCompletionEvidence: Version-bound manager/panel decision and delivered review/development/action record; signals alone cannot complete a retention action.
proposedRoleRecommendations.currentCapability: not registered or implemented; proposal only

proposedRoleRecommendations.name: Employee Relations Coordination Agent
proposedRoleRecommendations.boundary: Restricted concern, investigation, hearing and appeal coordination; humans own findings and sanctions.
proposedRoleRecommendations.extendExisting: Compliance remains a collaborator; its current broad mapping does not provide conflict-separated ER case stewardship.
proposedRoleRecommendations.deterministicAlternative: Deadline calculation, chain-of-custody and access/hold checks must be deterministic; sensitive deliberation must not be delegated to an AI decision maker.
proposedRoleRecommendations.justification: Contested evidence, independent review and restricted case access are a distinct boundary; approve only with an ER sponsor and restricted-system plan.
humanDecisionBoundaries: Independent qualified ER/investigator/legal humans own findings, discipline, appeals and retaliation safeguards; restricted evidence never becomes general conversation context.
proposedRoleRecommendations.requiredInputs: Current scoped subject/request, approved source object and policy versions, named human sponsor/decision, applicable evidence; outcome-specific schemas still need approval.
proposedCompletionEvidence: Restricted case version and authorized finding/decision or delivered notice/appeal disposition; intake does not prove an allegation.
proposedRoleRecommendations.currentCapability: not registered or implemented; proposal only
